Players Committee card image of [[Jabba's Prize (V)]] (original printing), a retired Virtual Modern card (Virtual Set 0).

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/jabbasprizefront.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). the PC deleted the file on 20 April 2022 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/2640d508acff17553640735ee7a15ad93fa78a65 holotable commit 2640d50]) when the card was retired.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.

== Preservation ==
archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-6/6b/V0-L-jabbasprizefront-2018-07-08.gif Internet Archive item].
